subject: Greenwave renewal: term realignment & burst plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenwavehealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Greenwave renewal: proposed timeline, term change & capacity bump

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Following up with a concise plan to get the renewal and expansion across the finish line without disrupting your production traffic. Attached: Greenwave_Renewal_Summary_v1.pdf and proposed-SOW.xlsx (pricing + staging plan).

High-level ask summary:
- Term change: move from month-to-month to a 12-month committed term (preferred start 2027-01-01).
- Capacity bump: reserve an additional 750M tokens/month (approx. 2x current peak); option to enable burst pool for seasonal spikes (+30% burst).
- Commercial: standard list pricing + 10% for annual commit; legal redline + procurement timeline to follow.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week of Nov 15: finalize stakeholder list and procurement contact (you)
- Nov 22: Redwood sends legal redline + final SOW
- Dec 6–10: QBR / renewal review (prefer Dec 8; see availability below)
- Dec 15: DocuSign execution target
- Jan 1, 2027: New term & capacity go live (staging run beforehand)

QBR windows — please confirm which of these work for your execs: Dec 7 (AM PT), Dec 8 (11am PT / 2pm ET), Dec 9 (PM PT).

Next steps from our side:
- I will send the legal redline (Evelyn) by Nov 22.
- Marissa will schedule the QBR and coordination call.
- Ben will book a short staging run and ops checklist.

A couple of clarifying asks from you: please confirm the procurement contact and whether data residency controls we discussed must be documented in the SOW (we can add a short addendum).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Lead | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Greenwave renewal: proposed timeline, term change & capacity bump

Thanks, Evelyn — helpful summary.

A few quick notes:
- Confirmed internal stakeholders: Priya (Procurement) and Marcus Li (CTO) will own review on our side. Adding Marcus above.
- Procurement note: we typically need a 2–3 week internal review for SOWs. Can you include a one-pager on cost delta vs. our current usage (line items)? Priya would like to see that.
- QBR: Dec 8 (11am PT) looks best for Marcus and me.
- Data residency: yes — we need a short clause confirming EU/US data residency options and KMS integration; please surface in the SOW.

I'll loop our legal contact after you send the redline.

Appreciate the clear timeline.

—Alex

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and confirming Marcus as the CTO contact. Per your asks I attached an updated SOW (Greenwave_SOW_v1.1.xlsx) that calls out:

1) Cost delta one-pager (see SOW tab "Summary") — shows monthly average vs committed; line items for reserved tokens and burst pool.
2) Data residency & KMS section — short addendum we can include in the SOW; I'll flag this to legal.
3) Procurement cadence — we'll allow a two-week review buffer; targeting DocuSign by Dec 15 as noted.

Summary of the commercial offer (TL;DR):
- 12-month committed term starting 2027-01-01
- Committed capacity: +750M tokens/month reserved (adds a 2x headroom)
- Burst pool: +30% capacity for up to 10 days/month (pay-as-you-go top-up)
- Pricing: list price on SOW; 10% discount applied for annual commitment
- Support: include Standard SLA; option to add Premium SLA for a fee (we can detail in addendum)

Action owners & near-term dates:
- Evelyn: send legal redline & data residency addendum by Nov 22 (EVELYN)
- Marissa: schedule QBR for Dec 8 (11am PT) and create calendar invite with agenda (MARISSA)
- Ben: schedule a 2-hour staging run the week of Dec 20 to validate burst path (BEN)
- Alex/Priya/Marcus: confirm procurement reviewer + preferred signature authority by Nov 20 (CUSTOMER)

If the above reads clean, I'll pass the SOW to our contracts team and include the data residency language.

One more note: if procurement needs a PO-first flow rather than DocuSign, let us know and we'll adjust the calendar.

Talk soon — I’ll follow up once legal has redlined.

Best,
Evelyn
